Topology.title: Azure Hybrid Cloud Hub-Spoke
Topology.Description: Secure hybrid cloud architecture with Azure hub-spoke topology, including a private ARO cluster in the spoke and shared services in the hub, connected to on-premises via ExpressRoute.
Topology.Summary: The hub contains shared services such as a firewall and a bastion host. The spoke network includes a private ARO cluster. The on-premises network has an OCP cluster and databases, connected to the hub via ExpressRoute. Public web traffic is protected by a WAF.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n_new1) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z_new1), which suggests the presence of an asset inventory system.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, nl3) and zone links (e.g., zl1, zl2, zl3) that document data flows between different components and zones.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for different types of workloads and services, such as 'Hub VNet' (z1), 'Spoke VNet' (z2), 'On-Premises Data Center' (z3), 'Non-Production Zone' (z6), and 'External Testing Zone' (z7).

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) and a 'Bastion Host' (n2) also in the 'Hub VNet'.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n13) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) and a link (nl8) from the DNS Server to the Azure Firewall (n1) for DNS resolution.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n12) in the 'Management Zone' (z5) with links (nl5, nl6, nl7) to the Azure Firewall (n1), Bastion Host (n2), and ExpressRoute Gateway (n7) for AAA integration.

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n14) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl9) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for DNS filtering.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n15) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl10) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for URL filtering.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a well-defined network architecture with distinct zones (e.g., Hub VNet, Spoke VNet, On-Premises Data Center) and secure components (e.g., Azure Firewall, Bastion Host, WAF).

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Repository' (n_new2) in the 'Management Zone' (z5) with a link (nl_new2) to the Identity Server (n12) for IaC management.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n12) in the 'Management Zone' (z5) with links (nl5, nl6, nl7) to the Azure Firewall (n1), Bastion Host (n2), and ExpressRoute Gateway (n7) for AAA integration.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'ExpressRoute Gateway' (n7) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl4) to the OCP Cluster (n4) in the 'On-Premises Data Center' (z3) and a link (nl7) to the Identity Server (n12) for AAA integration.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n20) in the 'Management Zone' (z5) with a link (nl15) to the Identity Server (n12) for admin access.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n16) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl11) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for intrusion detection.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple peering links (e.g., zl1, zl4) and data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2) that suggest traffic filtering between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n12) in the 'Management Zone' (z5) with links (nl5, nl6, nl7) to the Azure Firewall (n1), Bastion Host (n2), and ExpressRoute Gateway (n7) for AAA integration.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Flow Log Collector' (n_new3) in the 'Azure PaaS Services' zone (z4) with a link (nl_new3) to the Azure Monitor workspace (n11) for flow log collection.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n17) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl12) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for intrusion prevention.

Control.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n19) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl14) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for network access control.

Control.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n18) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) with a link (nl13) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for application layer filtering.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z6) with a representative workload (n_struct1) and a peering link (zl4) to the 'Hub VNet' (z1).

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Host' (n21) in the 'External Testing Zone' (z7) with a link (nl16) to the Azure Firewall (n1) for penetration testing and a 'Pen Test Scheduler' (n_new4) with a link (nl_new4) to the Penetration Testing Host (n21) for scheduling.
